Broderick Brian C increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 14.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Broderick Brian C bought 6,670 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 53,959 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.62M, up from 47,289 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Broderick Brian C who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $731.48B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.15% or $1.11 during the last trading session, reaching $95. About 25.59 million shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43% since April 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500.
